item.title: Pedestrian signal faulty, 29th September
item.description:
I've noticed quite frequently that when I press the pedestrian button, the red ring lights up but then goes off. Often, it doesn't end up switching to the pedestrian crossing, and the traffic signals just keep letting cars through while the pedestrian signal never activates. I have to press the button multiple times, or sometimes hold it down, before it eventually lets me cross. It can be intermittent, but I've experienced this quite often when trying to cross at these lights.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 2, Alstone Lane, Kingsditch, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
